introduction: The following special conditions apply specifically to this project and supplement the standard terms.

terms.title: Householder Planning Application - Preparation & Submission Only
terms.content: **Noble Architecture** will prepare a Householder Planning Application for the agreed scheme and submit it to **Rushcliffe Borough Council**. Noble Architecture's role as agent ends when the council confirms the application is valid. From then on the Client is responsible for the application, including all correspondence and negotiation with the planning officer, chasing, and any further reports or information the council asks for.

terms.title: Correspondence After Validation - Charged Hourly
terms.content: If the Client or the Local Planning Authority asks **Noble Architecture** to deal with the application after validation, that time will be charged at £50.00 per hour, unless the optional Managed Planning Application has been agreed. Minor amendments needing less than two hours remain free of charge, as set out in the standard terms. Any further design or drawing work the council requires will be quoted separately and agreed in writing before it starts.

terms.title: No Loft Conversion
terms.content: This appointment does not include a loft conversion, and none will be shown on the planning application. Loft conversions are specialist engineering work that needs a specialist roof survey, and this has not been priced. If the Client wants to explore converting the loft, this must be raised before the quotation is accepted, as it changes the survey, the design, the planning application and the fee.

terms.title: New Boundary Fence Included In The Application
terms.content: The existing hedge along the road is to be removed and a new fence put up on the boundary. A fence over one metre high next to a road used by vehicles is not permitted development under Class A of Part 2 of Schedule 2 to the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015. The new fence will therefore be shown on, and included in, the Householder Planning Application.

terms.title: Statutory Application Fee
terms.content: The Householder Planning Application fee is set by Government and paid to **Rushcliffe Borough Council**. It is £548.00 under the fee schedule in force from 1 April 2026. Government has proposed new planning fees from 8 December 2026, and the fee payable is the one in force on the day of submission. For this project the Client will pay the fee directly to the council, on its website or by phone, using the reference the council issues once it has received the application. The fee does not pass through **Noble Architecture**, and the standard term requiring funds to be transferred to Noble Architecture before submission does not apply unless the Client chooses the Planning Portal. The council will not validate the application until the fee is paid.

terms.title: Method Of Submission - Paper Form, Not The Planning Portal
terms.content: **Noble Architecture** will submit the application on the council's paper householder application form, sent directly to **Rushcliffe Borough Council**, and not through the national Planning Portal. This takes Noble Architecture about an extra hour, included in the quoted fee, and avoids the Portal's service charge, which for a householder application is £149.00 including VAT. The Portal can sometimes shorten validation by two or three days. If the Client asks for the Portal to be used instead, the Portal's service charge and the council's fee must be transferred to Noble Architecture and cleared at least one working day before submission.

terms.title: Optional Agency Services - **Optional Add-On
terms.content: The optional Managed Planning Application (£500.00 plus VAT) must be agreed in writing before the application is submitted. **Noble Architecture** will then be named as the Client's agent and will manage all dialogue with the Local Planning Authority through to the decision, with the design fees adjusted accordingly.
